_comment: Packaging for ONE role: what it needs to work (skills, plugins,
connections, keys) and the flows it ships with.
THE NAME AND FACE ARE NOT HERE. They live once, in roles/catalog.json,
which is the roster the client is shown -- and `roles/build_role.py`
injects that entry's `identity` into the distribution's role.json at build
time. Two copies is what this file used to be, and both drifted: after the
2026-08-22 redesign the catalog had Vera without her glasses and Tino with
his bow tie while every hired role kept serving the old face, because the
installed profile's role.json wins over the catalog in the adapter
(`_role_identity`). An `identity` key here is now a build failure.
The name and face still SHIP PRESET, which is the decision that has not
changed: hiring a role has to be one click, and opening a character editor
before the agent does anything puts an aesthetic choice in front of the
value. Renaming comes later, from the portal, and lands in
policy/roles/identities.json -- above this file, so an update never

env_requires.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
